Nowadays many city have problem with traffic. There are too many car on the road and the air become dirty. I think goverment should do something about this problem quickly.

First reason is that too many people buy car because it is cheap now. When everybody drive car the road is full and people waste many hour in traffic jam. This is bad for the work and also for the family time.

Second, the pollution from car make people sick. My uncle he have problem with breathing and the doctor say it is because of the bad air. If we not stop this, more people will get sick in future.

In my opinion the goverment can build more bus and train so people not need car. Also they can make the price of petrol high so less people drive. If we do these thing, the city will be more clean and the people will be more happy.
